objective: travel_cost_per_patient_distance * sum distance[county, facility] * assign + temporary_build_cost * sum build + extra_capacity_penalty * sum extra_beds

x.description: x coordinate of the county centroid
x.label: county centroid x coordinate

y.description: y coordinate of the county centroid
y.label: county centroid y coordinate

demand.description: Forecast COVID-19 patients needing a facility bed
demand.label: forecast COVID-19 patients

kind.description: existing (always open) or temporary (candidate site, opened at the build cost)
kind.label: facility kind

capacity.description: Patients the facility can treat (temporary: only if built)
capacity.label: facility capacity (beds)

travel_cost_per_patient_distance.unit: USD per patient per map unit
travel_cost_per_patient_distance.description: Travel cost per patient per unit of Euclidean distance
travel_cost_per_patient_distance.label: travel cost per patient per distance unit

temporary_build_cost.description: Fixed cost of building one temporary facility
temporary_build_cost.label: cost of building a temporary facility

extra_capacity_penalty.description: Penalty per extra bed added at a temporary site
extra_capacity_penalty.label: penalty per extra bed at a temporary site

decision_variables.assign[county, facility]: patients from the county treated at the facility (continuous >= 0)
decision_variables.build[facility]: binary, 1 if the temporary facility is built (temporary facilities only)
decision_variables.extra_beds[facility]: extra beds added at a temporary site, penalised (temporary facilities only)

constraints.demand[county]: sum over facilities of assign == demand
constraints.capacity[facility]: existing: sum over counties of assign <= capacity; temporary: sum of assign - extra_beds <= capacity * build

extra_beds.label: extra beds added at temporary sites
